headline: Bitcoin gave up its post-election bounce on Thursday afternoon, sliding to about $76,500 as US tech stocks sold off, while Polygon weighs a hard fork to return funds stolen in the Binance and Polymarket hacks.

market.asOf: Bitcoin level read from CoinDesk's live coverage at 15:24 UTC Thu 5 Nov; Fear & Greed read about 16:00 UTC. The market was moving fast, so use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 43 on the CoinMarketCap Crypto Fear & Greed Index, read about 16:00 UTC (the page showed no timestamp).

stories.title: Bitcoin loses $80,000 and slides toward $76,000 as tech stocks tumble
stories.summary: Bitcoin was back above $80,000 early Thursday, but it reversed after the US stock market opened and AI-chip stocks sold off. Bitcoin moved almost tick for tick with the Nasdaq, a reminder that crypto still trades like a high-risk tech stock. Many traders who had borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out.
points: Bitcoin was down about 5% over 24 hours at about $76,500 at 15:24 UTC, per CoinDesk; earlier it had climbed back above $80,000.
The Nasdaq Composite fell as much as 3.9%, and bitcoin dropped from above $80,800 to a low near $76,100, per Bitcoin Magazine.

Liquidation counts differ: Bitcoin Magazine says about $370M of leveraged positions, mostly longs, were wiped out in roughly an hour; CryptoPotato, citing CoinGlass, says over $560M in the past hour, $530M of it longs.
Ether fell below $2,300 and gold rose 1.1% to $4,116 an ounce, per CoinDesk.
Weekly US jobless claims fell to 189,000 from 195,000, which Bitcoin Magazine says gives the Fed little reason to ease.

stories.title: Polygon weighs a hard fork to return about $6.8M of POL stolen in the Binance and Polymarket hacks
stories.summary: Binance and Polymarket have proposed a Polygon hard fork that would move POL out of blocked attacker addresses and into recovery wallets, without changing total supply. It was due at Polygon's governance call at 14:30 UTC today; no outcome had been reported when this page was updated.
points: The fork would recover about 70.49M POL (about $6.8M): 46.63M POL for Binance and 23.86M POL for Polymarket, per Cointelegraph. Blockonomi puts the value at roughly $6.5M.
If approved, development and testing would take about two weeks, per Blockonomi.
The attacker offered validators cash to help unblock a transaction, per Blockonomi.
The Binance hack on 29 Oct was the largest on record; Cointelegraph puts it at $6.3B.

stories.title: Democrats' win in Congress puts crypto and Trump-linked tokens under pressure
stories.summary: Democrats will control Congress when it sits in January and plan investigations, including into the Trump family's crypto ventures. Crypto super PACs spent heavily and lost key races, including Ohio, where Sherrod Brown won. Crypto bills may move more slowly, but laws already passed, such as the stablecoin law, still stand.
points: Crypto super PACs spent about $176M across 100 seats; Fairshake and its affiliates spent $154.5M across 89 races and have over $67M left for 2028, per Cointelegraph.
More than $64M was spent to keep Jon Husted's Ohio seat, which Sherrod Brown won, per Cointelegraph.
Rep. Robert Garcia, expected to chair the House Oversight Committee, said the president has a crypto scheme making him billions, per Cointelegraph.
On 4 Nov the TRUMP memecoin fell 17% to $1.33 and WLFI fell over 7% to $0.047, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: ETF flows turned positive on 4 Nov
briefs.summary: Bitcoin ETFs took in $74.6M and ether funds $53M on Wednesday; BlackRock's IBIT lost another $201.2M, while Fidelity's FBTC led inflows with about $237M, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: HYPE drops about 15%
briefs.summary: Hyperliquid's token fell about 15% from its recent $96 high to just above $81, per CoinDesk's live coverage.

briefs.title: Staked Injective ETF approved for Nasdaq
briefs.summary: Nasdaq approved Canary Capital's staked INJ ETF, which would trade as INJC, and INJ rose about 10% in 24 hours before the afternoon selloff, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Arkansas sues Kalshi
briefs.summary: Arkansas's attorney general sued the prediction market, calling it illegal gambling; Kalshi has argued its contracts are CFTC-regulated derivatives, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack
briefs.summary: The French bank says customer funds were unaffected and would not confirm ZachXBT's estimate of more than $133M in suspicious withdrawals, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: South Korea moves to delay its crypto tax to 2029
briefs.summary: The plan would postpone a 22% tax on yearly crypto gains above 2.5M won by another two years, its fourth delay, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Mercado Bitcoin and BitMart hacks linked
briefs.summary: Mercado Bitcoin estimates about $38M affected and says customers won't bear the losses; BitMart's founder says the same group targeted its wallets, per The Cryptonomist.
